title.zh: 资管巨头施罗德代币化新兴市场债券基金已在Solana上线
title.en: 资管巨头施罗德代币化新兴市场债券基金已在Solana上线

current_state.zh: Schroders has launched its first tokenized investment strategy, the Schroder International Selection Fund Emerging Market Bond (SISF), on Solana, giving on-chain investors exposure to global emerging-market sovereign and corporate debt.
current_state.en: Schroders has launched its first tokenized investment strategy, the Schroder International Selection Fund Emerging Market Bond (SISF), on Solana, giving on-chain investors exposure to global emerging-market sovereign and corporate debt.
